summary: A free monthly improv workshop for LGBTQ+ participants, run by Misfit Improv (an Asheville improv/acting school) and hosted at Campaign for Southern Equality's Southern Equality Studios, with proceeds from optional donations benefiting that nonprofit. Every session across 15 listed dates is led by the same two named Misfit facilitators, Megan Piscitelle and Stevie Ramirez, but the listings describe it as a drop-in class open to newcomers each time rather than a group with continuing membership.

evidence.note: Description across all 15 monthly listings is identical and invites the public generally ("Join us... Come play with us!") with no reference to members, regulars, or a group name beyond the facilitators.
Location and organizer fields identify Misfit Improv AVL, a commercial improv/acting school, as the entity running the session, co-hosted at Campaign for Southern Equality's space.
Fetched listing confirms sessions are ticketed per-date as independent enrollments (second Thursday monthly) with no membership status, sign-up roster, or continuity requirement between sessions.
Misfit Improv's own site frames this as one of its recurring class/workshop offerings, run by its instructors, not as a self-organized community group with its own identity.

Search for the named facilitators (Megan Piscitelle, Stevie Ramirez) plus LGBTQ+ improv Asheville turned up no dedicated Facebook group, Meetup page, or community page for this specific workshop series.
